visualReasons: The bright Seed wide comparison demonstrates a visible local material refinement: the original two-bar pause silhouette is more isolated from pearl/stone highlights, while its dark backing stays compact and detached from score/forecast surfaces.
Darker Frostfruit wide and brighter portrait scenes retain a small recognizable pause action. The material does not turn the HUD into a continuous panel, interrupt the painting or cover board stars.

Default phone retains complete exact score/objective, all five ordered forecast destinations, distinct Help and selected-column underline/locator. The warm authored pause bars are complete and retain their proportions.

AX5 pressure and recovery retain the complete two-line score/objective and exact five-destination row. The full-column fact is complete in the pressure capture and absent after recovery; glyphs do not collide with the pause utility.

Sunny final words and full native footer actions remain readable over lit scenery. Spark retains its complete visible final tail and stacked reader actions inside the menu role; no gameplay-material claim is derived from that covered state.

Across the samples, the central sparse/dense star field and connected scenery preserve the middle Play reference hierarchy. The new utility backing remains subordinate, with no new decorative bezel or competing menu-scale surface.

Each JPEG preserves its raw composition and essential score, target, forecast, pressure, reader and control ink. No export-specific missing stroke, clipped fact, altered locator or orientation failure was observed.
limits: This is bounded static visual/export acceptance, separate from the reported Core, hosted and native mechanical results. It does not establish every painting, milestone, viewport or interaction state.

Seed 0 / 18 and Frostfruit 14 / 18 are historical 18-light restoration fixtures. They establish the shown painting/material contexts, not current Seed 11,000-point or Frostfruit 15,000-point encounter proof.
Normal-effects and quiet labels identify the recorded contexts. These still images do not establish continuous animation, press/release/cancel behavior or recognition during motion.
Platform focus, disabled appearance, Increased Contrast, Reduced Transparency, actual VoiceOver and physical-device perception were not performed or established by this review.

Forecast selection is a persistent underline/column locator; it is not evidence of platform focus. Help and practice Close retain their clear default by the stated source scope; no practice Close capture is among these 11 images.
No RGB contrast ratios were calculated from JPEG80 or resized previews. Any quantitative original-RGB measurements remain bound to the original PNG evidence and their separate methodology.

Sunny/Spark images establish the visible final text and actions after scrolling, not simultaneous visibility of every earlier line or independent proof of the pans. The stills do not prove hit-target sizes, saves, clocks or earned-event provenance.
